effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.slightly_tips: Gently sways and tilts your view after drinking alcohol.
effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.high_heels.de: Increases step height by half a block per effect level, letting you step over taller obstacles.
effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.grass_stealth: Sneak in suitable plants or mature crops to make nearby mobs stop targeting you. This slowly consumes hunger.
effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.vision.descri: Makes nearby creatures glow. Higher levels increase the detection range, up to 18 blocks.
effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.bloody_mary.d: Killing another creature heals you based on one third of its maximum health.
effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.ardent_heat.d: Sprint to smash through supported blocks ahead of you, consuming hunger and armor durability. Without armor, repeated collisions hurt you. Applies Hunger when it wears off.
effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.long_reach.de: Increases block and entity interaction range by three blocks per effect level.
effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.tomb_raider.d: Attacks against eligible creatures have a 30% chance to knock their main-hand item out of their grip. Damageable items are left nearly broken.
effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.xp_drain.desc: Attracts nearby experience orbs and removes the delay between collecting them.
effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.upside_down.d: Renames nearby mobs to Grumm, making them appear upside down. This replaces their existing custom names.
effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.zenith.descri: Teleports you to the surface directly above your position if you are underground, then applies Hunger.
effect.kaleidoscope_tavern.shriek_attack: Fires a sonic blast in the direction you are looking, damaging and knocking back creatures up to 32 blocks away. Damage is based on your current health.
